en-US.description: Upload a real-person clothing photo and a target model photo to generate a commercial apparel try-on image.
en-US.empty.realPersonImage: Please upload the real-person clothing image first
en-US.empty.targetModelImage: Please upload the target model image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Enhances fabric, knit, texture, button, zipper, and seam details for single-piece tops, bottoms, and dresses.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Balanced commercial try-on mode for regular production samples.
en-US.label: Real Model Try-On
en-US.samePatternReplace.help: Works better when the garment in the clothing photo shares the same silhouette as the garment already worn by the target model.
en-US.toast.success: Real model try-on image generated successfully!
en-US.upload.realPersonImage.help: Use an image with a clear main garment, visible structure, and minimal occlusion.
en-US.upload.targetModelImage.help: Use a target model image with a clear pose and a visible clothing area to replace.

zh-CN.description: 上传真人服饰图与目标模特图，一键生成服饰上身商拍图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 增强单件上衣、下装、连衣裙的材质、针织、纹理、纽扣、拉链、缝线等细节还原。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 适合常规商拍试衣样本，平衡效果稳定性与生成效率。
zh-CN.label: 真人图试衣
zh-CN.samePatternReplace.help: 服饰图与模特图的服饰为同版型时，试衣效果会更好哦！
zh-CN.toast.success: 真人图试衣图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.realPersonImage.help: 建议服饰主体清晰完整、遮挡少、版型轮廓明确。
zh-CN.upload.targetModelImage.help: 建议目标模特姿态清晰，待替换区域完整可见，避免大面积遮挡。
